request.text: In the opening minutes, a student defined a fraction as 'above 3, below 4,' focusing on notation. Later, when you showed a model with 8 parts, a student counted them all and said, 'Above to write, and 8 below,' but couldn't name the numerator. What do you think changed in their thinking between these two moments? And the next time you see a student focusing on the structure 'above, below,' what's the one small thing you'd want to try?
